$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Mesh to CAD
blocks.for: An STL exported from a CAD package back into one solid with real faces and edges (planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori, revolved and extruded faces, free-form sheets), written as a STEP file with a check of what a CAD program will make of it. In one step (stlToStep), or read first (readPart) and made later (makeStep), so the STL can be shown while the STEP is made.

internal.why: The engine's own: a debugging view of the faces found, for the package's probe scripts; the faces as read and corrections to them, for those scripts too; and the build's name, to trace a result to its source.
